stories.title: In Iran, child marriage risks complicated by war
stories.summary: War, poverty and disrupted schooling could put more girls in Iran at risk of child marriage, rights advocates have warned.

In Iran, rights advocates warn that war and mounting financial hardship could expose more girls to those risks. The warning comes as the first International Day for the Elimination of Child, Early and Forced Marriage is observed on November 27. The day was established during the UN General Assembly in 2025. Although there is no evidence linking child marriages to the war, cases illustrate the danger faced by girls married as children, often with limited means of escaping abuse. Three days later NATO confirmed that General Alexus Grynkewich, the commander of the alliance's European forces, had authorised the forward deployment of an AWACS aircraft.
